13	struct AvatarHeaderView<Footer: View>: View {
14	    private enum AvatarInfo {
15	        case room(RoomAvatar)
16	        case user(UserProfileProxy)
17	    }
18	    
19	    private enum Badge: Hashable {
20	        case encrypted(Bool)
21	        case historySharingState(RoomHistorySharingState)
22	        case `public`
23	        case verified
24	    }
25	    
26	    private let avatarInfo: AvatarInfo
27	    private let title: String
28	    private let subtitle: String?
29	    private let badges: [Badge]
30	    
31	    private let avatarSize: Avatars.Size
32	    private let mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol?
33	    private var onAvatarTap: ((URL) -> Void)?
34	    @ViewBuilder private var footer: () -> Footer
35	    
36	    init(room: RoomDetails,
37	         avatarSize: Avatars.Size,
38	         mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol? = nil,
39	         onAvatarTap: ((URL) -> Void)? = nil,
40	         @ViewBuilder footer: @escaping () -> Footer) {
41	        avatarInfo = .room(room.avatar)
42	        title = room.name ?? room.id
43	        
44	        if let roomAlias = room.canonicalAlias {
45	            subtitle = roomAlias
46	        } else if room.isDirect, case let .heroes(heroes) = room.avatar, heroes.count == 1 {
47	            subtitle = heroes[0].userID
48	        } else {
49	            subtitle = nil
50	        }
51	        
52	        self.avatarSize = avatarSize
53	        self.mediaProvider = mediaProvider
54	        self.onAvatarTap = onAvatarTap
55	        self.footer = footer
56	        
57	        var badges = [Badge]()
58	        badges.append(.encrypted(room.isEncrypted))
59	        if room.isPublic {
60	            badges.append(.public)
61	        }
62	        if let state = room.historySharingState {
63	            badges.append(.historySharingState(state))
64	        }
65	        self.badges = badges
66	    }
67	    
68	    init(accountOwner: RoomMemberDetails,
69	         dmRecipient: RoomMemberDetails,
70	         mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol? = nil,
71	         onAvatarTap: ((URL) -> Void)? = nil,
72	         @ViewBuilder footer: @escaping () -> Footer) {
73	        let dmRecipientProfile = UserProfileProxy(member: dmRecipient)
74	        avatarInfo = .room(.heroes([dmRecipientProfile, UserProfileProxy(member: accountOwner)]))
75	        title = dmRecipientProfile.displayName ?? dmRecipientProfile.userID
76	        subtitle = dmRecipientProfile.displayName == nil ? nil : dmRecipientProfile.userID
77	        
78	        avatarSize = .user(on: .dmDetails)
79	        self.mediaProvider = mediaProvider
80	        self.onAvatarTap = onAvatarTap
81	        self.footer = footer
82	        // In EL-X a DM is by definition always encrypted
83	        badges = [.encrypted(true)]
84	    }
85	    
86	    init(member: RoomMemberDetails,
87	         isVerified: Bool = false,
88	         avatarSize: Avatars.Size,
89	         mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol? = nil,
90	         onAvatarTap: ((URL) -> Void)? = nil,
91	         @ViewBuilder footer: @escaping () -> Footer) {
92	        let profile = UserProfileProxy(member: member)
93	        
94	        self.init(user: profile,
95	                  isVerified: isVerified,
96	                  avatarSize: avatarSize,
97	                  mediaProvider: mediaProvider,
98	                  onAvatarTap: onAvatarTap,
99	                  footer: footer)
100	    }
101	    
102	    init(user: UserProfileProxy,
103	         isVerified: Bool,
104	         avatarSize: Avatars.Size,
105	         mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol? = nil,
106	         onAvatarTap: ((URL) -> Void)? = nil,
107	         @ViewBuilder footer: @escaping () -> Footer) {
108	        avatarInfo = .user(user)
109	        title = user.displayName ?? user.userID
110	        subtitle = user.displayName == nil ? nil : user.userID
111	        
112	        self.avatarSize = avatarSize
113	        self.mediaProvider = mediaProvider
114	        self.onAvatarTap = onAvatarTap
115	        self.footer = footer
116	        badges = isVerified ? [.verified] : []
117	    }
118	    
119	    /// Initialises the view by using the sender,
120	    /// only to be used when a room member has not been loaded yet.
121	    init(sender: TimelineItemSender,
122	         avatarSize: Avatars.Size,
123	         mediaProvider: MediaProviderProtocol? = nil,

137	        HFlow(horizontalAlignment: .center,

143	                case .encrypted(true):
144	                    BadgeLabel(title: L10n.screenRoomDetailsBadgeEncrypted,

147	                case .encrypted(false):

151	                case .public:

155	                case .verified:

159	                case .historySharingState(.hidden):

162	                               style: .info)
163	                case .historySharingState(.shared):

167	                case .historySharingState(.worldReadable):

171	                }
172	            }
173	        }
174	    }

176	    private var avatarAccessibilityLabel: String {
177	        guard onAvatarTap != nil else {
178	            return L10n.a11yAvatar
179	        }
180	        switch avatarInfo {
181	        case .room(let roomAvatar):
182	            return roomAvatar.hasURL ? L10n.a11yViewAvatar : L10n.a11yAvatar
183	        case .user(let userProfileProxy):
184	            return userProfileProxy.avatarURL != nil ? L10n.a11yViewAvatar : L10n.a11yAvatar
185	        }
186	    }
187	    
188	    @ViewBuilder
189	    private var avatar: some View {
190	        switch avatarInfo {
191	        case .room(let roomAvatar):
192	            RoomAvatarImage(avatar: roomAvatar,

194	                            mediaProvider: mediaProvider,
195	                            onAvatarTap: onAvatarTap)
196	                .accessibilityLabel(avatarAccessibilityLabel)
197	            
198	        case .user(let userProfile):
199	            LoadableAvatarImage(url: userProfile.avatarURL,
200	                                name: userProfile.displayName,
201	                                contentID: userProfile.userID,
202	                                avatarSize: avatarSize,
203	                                mediaProvider: mediaProvider,
204	                                onTap: onAvatarTap)
205	                .accessibilityLabel(avatarAccessibilityLabel)
206	        }
207	    }
208	    
209	    var body: some View {
210	        VStack(spacing: 8.0) {
211	            avatar
212	            
213	            Spacer()
214	                .frame(height: 9)
215	            
216	            Text(title)
217	                .foregroundColor(.compound.textPrimary)
218	                .font(.compound.headingMDBold)
219	                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
220	                .textSelection(.enabled)
221	            
222	            if let subtitle {

226	                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
227	                    .textSelection(.enabled)

229	            
230	            if !badges.isEmpty {

238	        .listRowInsets(EdgeInsets(top: 11,
239	                                  leading: 0,
240	                                  bottom: 11,
241	                                  trailing: 0))

Based on my comprehensive search of the Element X iOS codebase, I've found where user/avatar images are displayed in full screen. Here's the detailed report:

## Full-Screen Avatar Display Implementation

### Primary Files:

**Avatar Size Definitions:**
- **File**: `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/element-x-ios/ElementX/Sources/Other/Avatars.swift`
  - **Lines 117-118**: User avatar size for member details
  ```swift
  case .memberDetails, .editUserDetails:
      96
  ```
  **Dimensions: 96x96 points (UIKit points)** - This is the size used when displaying user avatars at large/full screen in member details and user profile screens.

### Screens Implementing Full-Screen Avatar Display:

1. **User Profile Screen**
   - **File**: `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/element-x-ios/ElementX/Sources/Screens/UserProfileScreen/View/UserProfileScreen.swift`
   - **Line 31**: `.interactiveQuickLook(item: $context.mediaPreviewItem, allowEditing: false)`
   - **Line 41**: Avatar size `.user(on: .memberDetails)` = **96x96 points**
   - **Line 43**: Tap handler calls `context.send(viewAction: .displayAvatar(url))`

2. **Room Member Details Screen**
   - **File**: `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/element-x-ios/ElementX/Sources/Screens/RoomMemberDetailsScreen/View/RoomMemberDetailsScreen.swift`
   - **Line 38**: `.interactiveQuickLook(item: $context.mediaPreviewItem, allowEditing: false)`
   - **Line 48**: Avatar size `.user(on: .memberDetails)` = **96x96 points**
   - **Line 50**: Tap handler calls `context.send(viewAction: .displayAvatar(url))`

3. **Room Details Screen**
   - **File**: `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/element-x-ios/ElementX/Sources/Screens/RoomDetailsScreen/View/RoomDetailsScreen.swift`
   - **Line 59**: `.interactiveQuickLook(item: $context.mediaPreviewItem, allowEditing: false)`
   - **Line 66**: Avatar size `.room(on: .details)` = **96x96 points**
   - **Line 68**: Tap handler calls `context.send(viewAction: .displayAvatar(url))`

### Full-Screen Image Viewer Implementation:

- **File**: `/Users/stjepandzojic/projects/element-x-ios/ElementX/Sources/Screens/FilePreviewScreen/InteractiveQuickLook.swift`
  - **Lines 101-106**: Source view for QuickLook transition has fixed dimensions:
    ```swift
    NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
        sourceView.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
        sourceView.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.bottomAnchor),
        sourceView.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 200),
        sourceView.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 200)
    ])
    ```
  - **Source view dimensions: 200x200 points** (used as the animation source for the QuickLook transition)

### Key Findings:

1. **Avatar display size at large/full screen**: **96x96 points**
2. **QuickLook source view for animation**: **200x200 points**
3. The actual full-screen display is handled by Apple's `QLPreviewController`, which renders the image at full device screen dimensions
4. Avatar scaling respects dynamic type via `@ScaledMetric`, so the actual pixel dimensions vary based on user's accessibility text size settings
